review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner (self-review, not independent approval)
review.decision: Implement lazy recorded tool details and shared typed presentation
review.notes: The supplied GitHub call has arguments/result/status in the native completion but selected-key parsing drops the query arguments and ignores its result. Retain existing session/home/guest policy and 32MiB exact-record reader. No result bodies enter transcript polls/cache. Full reads redact structured credentials and label redaction, not claim byte-for-byte raw when normalized. Command source remains unchanged. Shared TS presentation is generated for Web and used by RN Chat/Trace. Browser synthetic rendering and RN actions are evidence at their own layers, not installed iOS touch/VoiceOver. No release/install or real-session mutation.

cases.description: Native tool details are lazy, bounded and scoped
cases.setup: Synthetic Codex McpToolCall with repository/hash arguments, structured/text/error/empty results and a large result; ordinary polls and on-demand reads.
cases.action: Parse then read each exact reference.
cases.expected: Polls contain only bounded selected inputs and call metadata, never result bodies; owner reads recover recorded arguments/results, reject rewritten/foreign/oversized records and redact structured credentials.

cases.description: Native mirrors enrich the original call without duplicating or replacing original command input
cases.setup: Legacy function call followed by native completion with same ID, then incremental/restart parsing.
cases.action: Read the original input and separate native detail references.
cases.expected: One call remains, original input/ref stays intact, result and status remain available by exact native ref; unrelated IDs are distinct.

cases.description: Shared typed presentation distinguishes tool information and empty states
cases.setup: Synthetic query, command, file change, wait/agent, empty/error/missing results and old-server steps.
cases.action: Build shared presentation and inspect Preview/Raw/labels.
cases.expected: Queries expose named parameters and readable structured/text results; commands keep original source, files retain changes, unknown tools have factual fallback; pending/failed/empty/unrecorded are distinct, raw contains recorded sanitized fields and does not silently truncate.

cases.description: App Trace and Chat load and present the same recorded call details
cases.setup: Render shared tool details and Trace with synthetic clients, delayed responses and identity changes.
cases.action: Open tabs, retry failure, switch session and copy raw.
cases.expected: Tool-specific name, provider/status/duration, parameters/results are visible; no false summary-only warning, stale responses cannot cross sessions, original source remains verbatim, copy is complete and disabled while incomplete.

cases.description: Web uses shared analysis and readable constrained detail layout
cases.setup: Synthetic desktop and mobile-width Trace/Chat with recorded MCP query, command and missing/failed results.
cases.action: Open details/Preview/Raw, switch calls, retry and resize.
cases.expected: Both surfaces show the same facts and nonempty recorded values; controls remain reachable, no horizontal document overflow or console errors, pending/error states are actionable and old-server fallback remains meaningful.
